items.title: 67255_Helen Humes oral history interview
items.q: The personnel is ... Walter Page ... And I'll never forget one time, we was playing ... there was the bass up in there. He done fell off the stand.

ctx.x: Walter Page. We was just playing and playing and we looked around and there was the bass up in there. He done fell off the stand. (laughs) There was the bass--- I said, oh, my Lord, did he hurt hisself. No, he was just holding the bass up standing down there just a pickin ... I said, oh, my goodness!
Listen, Basie always used to make out like he was embarrassed because he didn't play that
